granule_pedigree.limitation: Official positive human entity membership verified. Target proteomics supplement/peptides and lumen topology or secretion remain unverified; precise locations are UNDECIDED.

superseded_authored_annotation.disposition: Only the prior authored NEW microtubule-binding assertion is withdrawn under the explicit project instruction forbidding a NEW ancestor or descendant of an existing term. GO:0008017 is a descendant of existing positive GO:0005515; its experimentally supported MF remains in the core. This is a project authoring constraint, not a claim that broad protein binding is as informative as microtubule binding. All 99 machine assertions, including NOT GO:0051011, remain intact.

source_access.scope: Canonical cache is abstract-only; genuine author PDF was recovered and selected Results/Figures 3–5 and reporter/fractionation/morpholino Methods read. Human construct Y2H/reporter/fractionation, bovine retinal co-IP, IMCD3/COS7 centrosome imaging and zebrafish developmental perturbations are distinguished.

Full cached selected human-cell Results/Methods: CP110/CEP290 association, target depletion and Rab8a localization. Licensing of a specific assay species/construct is not inferred from the gene symbol alone.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine old-PMC full HTML selected Results/Methods read. Human CEP290 fragments and human NPHP5 were tested in HEK293T co-IP/lysate pull-downs; fragment self-association does not establish intact oligomer stoichiometry. Xenopus functional assays are separate.

Full selected Methods/Results plus exact human RPE anti-tag interaction record read. Stable LAP-tag lines span NIH3T3, IMCD3 and RPE models; NPHP5/CEP290 associations and cellular ciliation results are retained with that scope.

Abstract-only primary cache. The exact positive IntAct target record independently matches human CEP290/CP110, the PMID and anti-bait co-IP assay in HEK293 cells. The paper’s KIF24 mechanism is not transferred to CEP290; no complete manuscript read claimed.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine full PMC HTML and Figure 1C pixels read. The human-cell CP110 immunoprecipitate includes CEP290. The main NEURL4 focus does not invalidate this exact partner assay.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine full PMC selected Results/Figure 1 and Methods read. Tagged CEP290/MKKS association, domain two-hybrid and retinal assays use mixed construct/species contexts; mouse genetic rescue is not a human biochemical assay.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; indexed author-uploaded full Results/Figure 3 and assay descriptions read. Endogenous human HEK293 co-IP supports CEP131 and pericentrin pairs; HeLa depletion supports contextual CEP131 targeting. No full local byte-copy success claimed.
Full selected Figure 2F–G/Methods and exact interaction records read: human CEP290 1917–2479 versus ZNF423 178–406 in Y2H/tagged co-IP. No CEP164/ZNF423 DNA-damage activity is assigned to CEP290.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine full PMC selected Results/Methods read. Reciprocal endogenous human HEK293 co-IP and binding-sensitive fragment/mutant mapping directly support NPHP5 association.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine fresh normal full-text variant was read externally to it. Reciprocal endogenous CEP162/CEP290 co-IP and cellular recruitment experiments support association. Failure of cellular full-length CEP290 to decorate microtubules is contextually distinct from the later purified-domain positive result; neither entire paper is declared refuted.

Canonical cache contains only parts of the article despite its full flag. Indexed original PMC Results/Figures 1–2 were recovered: endogenous human HEK293T complex association and hTERT-RPE1 localization are explicit; mouse retinal/genetic experiments remain separate. No purified binary or complete construct-method verification claimed.

Full selected Methods/Results read: human-cell CP110/Talpid3-associated complexes, CEP290 depletion, Rab8a rescue and vesicle-stage TEM. Initial small-vesicle docking is separable from later capped-vesicle maturation; rescue does not establish CEP290 GEF or fusion catalysis.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine fresh normal full variant read, including Figure S2A/C descriptions. FLAG/S-AZI1 co-IP from stable human 293T cells and RPE1 localization corroborate CEP290 association/location; condition-dependent redistribution is scoped.

Canonical abstract and exact positive target interaction records read. Human CCDC13 and CEP131 pairs are supported by co-IP records with actual tagging/complex-expansion limits; no entire full manuscript or CEP290 genome-stability assay claimed.

Target-specific IntAct records were inspected alongside the cached screen source. Positive pair uses the human CEP290 941–1104 fragment with fusion tags in Y2H. Pooling/array records do not establish full-length endogenous binding.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine full PMC selected Results/Methods read. NPHP5 construct co-IP, endogenous proximity, BBSome composition and human ciliary-entry measurements are distinguished; no general motor or GEF activity inferred.

Canonical abstract cache preserved. Exact target records distinguish anti-tag affinity-purification from BioID proximity in the human centrosome/cilium network; biochemical association records ground the four retained pairs, with tagging and complex-expansion limitations. A genuine fresh normal full-text variant is available separately; canonical abstract bytes remain unchanged.

Full selected Methods/Figure 5D read: tagged CCDC66/CEP290 anti-GFP co-IP in HEK293T cells supports association beyond BioID. Microtubule bundle recruitment is not treated as a purified CEP290 binding assay.
The exact positive BioPlex human HEK293T pair and assay/host/tag/expansion fields were inspected. No independent full-network reconstruction or purified binary interaction is claimed.

Three exact positive HuRI pairs and their construct fields were inspected. CEP290 941–1104 is screened against human proteins in a yeast host. Pooling, array and validation records are not misrepresented as separate endogenous experiments.
Exact positive human HEK293T BioPlex pair inspected, with C-terminal tagged-bait and spoke-expansion fields. Association is retained without generalizing from one host to all tissues.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; indexed original publisher full Results/Figures 3–5 and Methods read. Human HEK293T GFP–CCDC66 co-IP supports endogenous CEP290 association; human RPE1 staining supports TZ location. Mouse IMCD3 miniTurbo is a separate assay.

Full review synthesis read for TZ modules and location. This is a secondary source, with mechanistic hierarchy traced to primary ortholog evidence and human imaging rather than treated as a new experiment.

Authentic abstract-only human centrosome-proteomics cache read; the exact target measurement/supplement was not recovered. Broad cytoplasmic and centrosomal locations are independently supported, so no wrong-target conclusion follows.

Full selected human hTERT-RPE Figure 4 Results/legend read. CEP290 puncta overlap pericentrin and are redistributed by CK1δ depletion without reduced total protein; control localization supports the reviewed compartment.

Authentic full-flag cache and human centrosome-method context inspected, but the exact CEP290 table/panel was not independently recovered. Independent human imaging resolves the compartment, not the source-specific target assay.

Canonical abstract cache preserved; genuine fresh normal full-text variant selected Figure 6C read. Human RPE1 CEP290 staining supports basal-body/centriole-associated location; Girdin-specific function is not transferred.

Full selected C. elegans Results/Figures 3–5, rescue and ultrastructural evidence read. The detailed CEP-290/MKS-5 assembly hierarchy and gating phenotypes are ortholog experiments; conserved human core inference is distinguished from a human reconstitution.

Authentic NK-like YTS membrane-proteome abstract read; exact CEP290 target peptides/fraction were not retrieved. Independent human CEP290 membrane association supports the broad compartment without validating a specific NK-cell topology.

Full selected human construct/purification and liposome/MT Results/Methods independently read. Bacterial 6xHis 1–580 binds PS/cholesterol liposomes ; 1695–1966 binds polymerized bovine MTs. Predicted helix 257–292 is not an isolated tested necessary interface. Native full-length Y-link bridging and exclusive rd16 causality remain models/limitations.

Full main Methods/Results inspected: KIAA0586 assays are explicit, with CEP290 discussed through earlier work. Exact source-specific CEP290 IDA linkage is unresolved; independent primary studies support the biological annotation. This is not a title-based wrong-gene allegation.

Genuine full normal cache newly selected. Mouse rd16 retinal localization/protein-distribution Results inspected; multiresidue deletion changes protein abundance and partner/localization behavior, not exclusively one molecular interface. Supports source-specific mouse donor context.

Genuine full normal cache reused exactly from current main. Tctn1-LAP affinity purification and chromatography in mouse NIH3T3 recover CEP290; tagged COS1 co-IP was not reproducible, allowing peripheral/substoichiometric association. Human RPE1 location data are separate.

Exact current-main abstract cache preserved; indexed original full Methods/Results/Discussion were independently inspected. Whole human neutrophil fractions were solubilized for MS. Exact CEP290 supplementary target row, peptide evidence, luminal topology and release were not recovered; authentic supplement binary routes were blocked. Official Reactome linkage is verified, not the precise biological localization.
